__doc__: Workframe-private sidecar — not a Claude Code official file. Action -> role map for main-session role-memory delivery (scripts/_role_memory.py). Keys under each role are FULL skill names with the plugin prefix, exactly as the Skill tool's tool_input.skill and UserPromptExpansion's command_name carry them (e.g. core:test-case-design). A skill listed under no role is 'unmapped': it is logged, nothing is delivered. Path-triggered delivery (first edit inside a module's code_paths) always means dev and is NOT configured here. One copy in the framework, shipped with the plugin; no project override.
